name: Haus Alpin
beschreibung: Haus Alpin is located in Ellmau in Tirol. The accommodation offers self-catering holiday apartments. The apartments include a living area, a kitchenette, bedrooms and a bathroom. Guests have access to a garden, a terrace and parking spaces. Ellmau town centre and the mountain railway are within walking distance. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Shops and restaurants are located in the nearby area.
